params.name: query
params.description: The SPARQL query string to execute

params.name: default-graph-uri
params.description: Specifies the default graph for the query. Multiple values may be provided to define a dataset with a merged default graph.

params.name: named-graph-uri
params.description: Specifies a named graph for the query dataset. Multiple values may be provided.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Maximum execution time for the query in milliseconds. Not part of the W3C specification but commonly supported by SPARQL endpoints.

items.docs: Executes a SPARQL query operation using HTTP GET. The query string is passed as a URL parameter. This method is suitable for queries that fit within URL length limits. Supports SELECT, ASK, CONSTRUCT, and DESCRIBE query forms.

params.name: default-graph-uri
params.description: Specifies the default graph for the query. Multiple values may be provided to define a dataset with a merged default graph.

params.name: named-graph-uri
params.description: Specifies a named graph for the query dataset. Multiple values may be provided.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Maximum execution time for the query in milliseconds. Not part of the W3C specification but commonly supported by SPARQL endpoints.

items.docs: Executes a SPARQL query operation using HTTP POST. The query can be sent as a URL-encoded form parameter or directly in the request body. This method supports arbitrarily long queries that may exceed URL length limits.
